title: Maestro User Identity
description: Persisted by the maestro-onboarding skill (Steps 3 and 3.5). Carries name, role, current focus (populated in both quick and complete tracks by Q9 of the sequence), and — when the user picks the complete track — the additional professional context that drives the CLAUDE.md advisory posture (contexto profissional / evolução do OS). Empty strings for work_energy/quality_bar when track = quick.

name.description: Name the user uses at BCG Brasil.

role.description: BCG role (e.g., Consultant, Senior Consultant, Manager).

focus.description: Current project or area of focus. Populated by Q9 of the guided sequence in both the quick and complete tracks.

work_energy.description: What consumes most energy right now, in the user's own words. Populated only when track = complete.

quality_bar.description: What defines well-done work for the user on this project, in the user's own words. Populated only when track = complete.

track.description: Which onboarding track the user picked. Mirrors onboarding.json.track. Determines whether work_energy/quality_bar are populated (complete only); focus is populated in every guided track.

captured_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the capture.
